Memories embedded before PR #263 repeat every 32 dimensions, so they miss queries from the fixed fallback. A gated re-embed script finds those vectors and rewrites them only when you ask it to.

The script is `artifacts/v2/scripts/reembed-fallback.mjs`. It scans JSON and JSONL records for the repeating 32-dimension signature and recomputes them with the fixed `localFallbackEmbedding`. A dry run is the default and only prints counts. It writes only with `--apply` and `TESSERA_REEMBED_APPLY=1`. That flag defaults to `0`.

On the existing mesh-log set (156 lines with at least 8 words, 6-word queries, 20 seeds, 3120 queries), detection of the old vectors from git history versus the fixed function was precision **1.0** and recall **1.0**. Top-1 retrieval went from **0.96%** before re-embedding to **90.51%** after. The v2 suite (122 tests) passed on Node 22.
